title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
summary: Find target in a strictly increasing array that may have been cyclically shifted.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–5,000 distinct integers. Entries and target are in [−10,000, 10,000]. The input is increasing or is a rotation of an increasing array.

statement: Find target in a strictly increasing array that may have been cyclically shifted. Return its zero-based index in the supplied array, or −1 if absent. Use logarithmic time.

examples.explanation: The target is in the lower-valued block.

constraints: 1–5,000 distinct integers. Entries and target are in [−10,000, 10,000]. The input is increasing or is a rotation of an increasing array.
hints: Conceptual: At least one side of a midpoint is still in increasing order.
Directional: Identify that side and check whether its endpoint values can contain the target.
Implementation: Check the midpoint first. Keep the sorted side only when the target is in its range. Otherwise search the other side.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Each step discards half the remaining positions.
